purpose: Defines fixed column schemas for calibration output CSV files and helper functions to construct JSON winner/config documents. The module supplies canonical headers for multiple output formats (boundary sweep, contact sweep, alignment metrics, etc.) and provides utilities to assemble structured winner-selection payloads.

public_api.name: FROZEN_ROW_COLUMNS
public_api.role: Tuple of core column names appearing in most calibration outputs (performance metrics, detection counts, parameter values)

public_api.name: TOLERANCE_FRAME_COLUMNS
public_api.role: Tuple of tolerance-based frame thresholds (1, 2, 5, 10 frame variants)

public_api.name: BOUNDARY_DIAGNOSTIC_COLUMNS
public_api.role: Tuple of diagnostic columns specific to boundary detection (coverage, alignment, merge metrics)

public_api.name: BOUNDARY_SWEEP_COLUMNS
public_api.role: Complete column schema for boundary_sweep.csv; combines frozen rows, diagnostics, and tolerance columns

public_api.name: CONTACT_SWEEP_COLUMNS
public_api.role: Complete column schema for contact_sweep.csv; frozen rows plus impulse/dedup/smoothing parameters and tolerances

public_api.name: BEST_CONFIG_COMPARISON_COLUMNS
public_api.role: Column schema for best_config_comparison.csv; includes rule name and coverage gaps

public_api.name: CONTACT_FRONTIER_COLUMNS
public_api.role: Alias for CONTACT_SWEEP_COLUMNS; used for contact_frontier.csv output

public_api.name: CONTACT_STABILITY_COLUMNS
public_api.role: Column schema for contact_stability.csv; contact sweep columns plus a winner-stability flag

public_api.name: SPLIT_LOG_COLUMNS
public_api.role: Column schema for split_log.csv; tracks rally pieces and their spans across videos

public_api.name: ALIGNMENT_COLUMNS
public_api.role: Base column schema for alignment metrics (rule, rally count, median and p90 offset)

public_api.name: ALIGNMENT_OWN_COVERED_COLUMNS
public_api.role: Column schema for alignment_own_covered.csv; alias for ALIGNMENT_COLUMNS

public_api.name: ALIGNMENT_SHARED_COLUMNS
public_api.role: Column schema for alignment_shared.csv; alias for ALIGNMENT_COLUMNS

public_api.name: CSV_COLUMNS_BY_FILENAME
public_api.role: Dict mapping output filenames to their column tuples; allows code to look up the schema for a given CSV file

public_api.name: serialise_winner_strategy
public_api.role: Converts strategy enum values to their string names for JSON serialisation; passes through non-enum values unchanged

public_api.name: winner_spec
public_api.role: Builds a single phase's winner config from numeric overrides and strategy choices; returns a dict with 'overrides_base30' and 'strategies' keys

public_api.name: winner_document
public_api.role: Constructs the complete config_winner.json payload; assembles metadata and optional boundary/contact phase specs with provenance tracking

public_api.name: WINNER_JSON_META_KEY, WINNER_JSON_BOUNDARY_KEY, WINNER_JSON_CONTACT_KEY, WINNER_JSON_PHASE_KEYS, WINNER_JSON_META_KEYS, WINNER_JSON_VERDICT_ISSUED, WINNER_JSON_TOLERANCES_BASE30, WINNER_SPEC_OVERRIDES_KEY, WINNER_SPEC_STRATEGIES_KEY, WINNER_SPEC_KEYS
public_api.role: String constants defining JSON document structure and keys used by winner/config serialisation
